_comment_pitchDistanceMeters: Pitch distance from release area to home plate [m]
_comment_enableMoundHeightOffset: Apply mound height offset to player viewpoint
_comment_moundHeightOffsetMeters: Mound height offset [m] (always applied to pitch release/zone space)
_comment_windVelocityX: Wind velocity X [m/s], positive to batter-right.
_comment_windVelocityZ: Wind velocity Z [m/s], positive toward home plate.
_comment_windShearFactor: Cross-wind shear factor [m/s per meter above reference height].
_comment_batLengthMeters: Total bat length from knob face to tip [m].
_comment_ballRestitutionAtReferenceSpeed: Base ball COR at 71.5264 m/s closing speed, before bat material and contact-position corrections.
_comment_batAngleOffsetDegrees: Bat angle offset around local right axis [deg].
_comment_batYawOffsetDegrees: Bat yaw offset around controller local up axis [deg].
